patch.role: Space-only trimming of the quote specification: restores A for space padding.

inputs.expose_tab_padding: quote specification padded with tabs: A trims them, the space-only repair does not

rationale: validate_smartquotes_locales() trims the quote specification before requiring exactly four characters. The patch restores the trimming for space padding only; tab padding survives the repair and fails the four-character check, which is the exposing witness.
